description: Create an AI music generation task on Lacuna. Returns immediately with a `pending` task; use `wait_for_generation` or `get_generation` to retrieve the finished tracks.

instrumental.description: Generate an instrumental track (no lyrics). Defaults to false.

lyrics.description: Lyrics in plain text. Required unless `instrumental` is true.

model.description: Generation model. Defaults to `aether`. Use `echo` for full structured tracks up to three minutes.

negative_tags.description: Negative style tags to avoid (aether only).

style.description: Style description, e.g. "pop, female vocal, 120 bpm, energetic".

name: generate_music
title: Generate music
